summary.text: Justin Ready is the Republican state senator for Maryland District 5, in office since February 2015, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Gary Foote. He previously served in the Maryland House of Delegates from 2011 to 2015.

paragraphs.text: Ready earned an associate degree from Carroll Community College and a B.A. in political science from Salisbury University in 2004.
His professional experience includes owning Strategic CFM and working as a legislative aide to Delegate J.B. Jennings and Chief of Staff Janet Greenip.
Ready represented District 5 in the House of Delegates from 2011 to 2015 and joined the Senate on February 2, 2015, succeeding Joseph Getty.
In the 2025-2026 term he serves on the Finance, Rules and Executive Nominations committees, among others.
